title: Futbol Manager
desc: Football Manager helps you organize lightning championships with date generation, rest days, results, reusable referees and pitches with location.

title: Dota 2 Hero Quiz
desc: A quiz game built with React and TypeScript where you guess Dota 2 heroes. Features a global leaderboard powered by Supabase, country flags, and round tracking.

title: Disfrutones
desc: A custom WordPress theme built from scratch, designed with a clean and modern aesthetic. The theme uses Lazy Blocks to create reusable Gutenberg blocks, allowing flexible page composition without relying on page builders.
